COMMANDS (93)
  attach-session        attach or switch to a session
  bind-key              bind a key to a command
  break-pane            break a pane from an existing into a new window
  capture-pane          capture the contents of a pane to a buffer
  choose-buffer         put a pane into buffer choice mode
  choose-client         put a window into client choice mode
  choose-tree           put a window into tree choice mode
  clear-history         remove and clear history for a pane
  clear-prompt-history  [-T prompt-type]
  clock-mode            enter clock mode
  command-prompt        open the tmux command prompt in a client
  confirm-before        run a command but ask for confirmation before
  copy-mode             enter copy mode
  customize-mode        enter customize mode
  delete-buffer         delete a paste buffer
  detach-client         detach a client from the server
  display-menu          display a menu
  display-message       display a message in the status line
  display-panes         display an indicator for each visible pane
  display-popup         display a popup box over a pane
  find-window           search for a pattern in windows
  has-session           check and report if a session exists on the server
  if-shell              execute a tmux command if a shell-command succeeded
  join-pane             split a pane and move an existing one into the new space
  kill-pane             destroy a given pane
  kill-server           kill clients, sessions and server
  kill-session          destroy a given session
  kill-window           destroy a given window
  last-pane             select the previously selected pane
  last-window           select the previously selected window
  link-window           link a window to another
  list-buffers          list paste buffers of a session
  list-clients          list clients attached to server
  list-commands         list supported sub-commands
  list-keys             list all key-bindings
  list-panes            list panes of a window
  list-sessions         list sessions managed by server
  list-windows          list windows of a session
  load-buffer           load a file into a paste buffer
  lock-client           lock a client
  lock-server           lock all clients attached to the server
  lock-session          lock all clients attached to a session
  move-pane             move a pane, or reposition a floating one
  move-window           move a window to another
  new-pane              create a new floating pane
  new-session           create a new session
  new-window            create a new window
  next-layout           move a window to the next layout
  next-window           move to the next window in a session
  paste-buffer          insert a paste buffer into the window
  pipe-pane             pipe output from a pane to a shell command
  previous-layout       move a window to the previous layout
  previous-window       move to the previous window in a session
  refresh-client        refresh a client
  rename-session        rename a session
  rename-window         rename a window
  resize-pane           resize a pane
  resize-window         resize a window
  respawn-pane          reuse a pane in which a command has exited
  respawn-window        reuse a window in which a command has exited
  rotate-window         rotate positions of panes in a window
  run-shell             execute a command without creating a new window
  save-buffer           save a paste buffer to a file
  select-layout         choose a layout for a pane
  select-pane           make a pane the active one in the window
  select-window         select a window
  send-keys             send key(s) to a window
  send-prefix           send the prefix key to a window
  server-access         [-adglrw] [-t target-pane] [user|group]
  set-buffer            set contents of a paster buffer
  set-environment       (un)set an environment variable
  set-hook              set a hook to a command
  set-option            set a session option
  set-window-option     set a window option
  show-buffer           display the contents of a paste buffer
  show-environment      display the environment
  show-hooks            show the global list of hooks
  show-messages         show client's message log
  show-options          show session options
  show-prompt-history   [-T prompt-type]
  show-window-options   show window options
  source-file           execute tmux commands from a file
  split-window          splits a pane into two
  start-server          start a tmux server
  suspend-client        suspend a client
  swap-pane             swap two panes
  swap-window           swap two windows
  switch-client         switch the client to another session
  switch-mode           put a pane into switch (session/window picker) mode
  unbind-key            unbind a key
  unlink-window         unlink a window
  wait-for              wait for an event or trigger it
  znative               install and load tmux plugins, native (Rust cdylib) or TPM script (ztmux extension)

EXTENSIONS (114)
  active                focused window/pane of every session (ztmux extension)
  age                   sessions ranked by creation age, oldest first (ztmux extension)
  ahead                 how far each repo is ahead of/behind upstream (ztmux extension)
  alerts                windows with a pending bell/activity/silence alert (ztmux extension)
  autolock              sessions set to lock themselves after idle time (ztmux extension)
  autoname              windows with a pinned name (automatic-rename off) (ztmux extension)
  banner                the ztmux banner: logo, verb totals and live server counts (ztmux extension)
  bcast                 broadcast a command to many panes at once (ztmux extension)
  borders               windows that draw a status line on their pane borders (ztmux extension)
  buffers               the server's paste buffers, largest first (ztmux extension)
  busy                  panes running a program, not idle at a prompt (ztmux extension)
  changes               uncommitted file count per pane's repo, dirtiest first (ztmux extension)
  clearall              free the scrollback of every pane (ztmux extension)
  cmd                   histogram of commands running across panes (ztmux extension)
  commit                the last commit in every pane's repo (ztmux extension)
  conflicts             repos with unresolved merge conflicts (ztmux extension)
  connected             attached clients ranked by connection age (ztmux extension)
  constrain             attached clients ranked by screen size, smallest first (ztmux extension)
  control               clients attached in control mode (-CC) (ztmux extension)
  cwd                   working directories in use, busiest first (ztmux extension)
  dashboard             live ratatui server dashboard (ztmux extension)
  dead                  dead panes still held open in a window (ztmux extension)
  dedup                 find redundant panes (same cwd + command) (ztmux extension)
  density               windows ranked by pane count, most first (ztmux extension)
  destroy               sessions that self-destruct when the last client detaches (ztmux extension)
  detached              sessions with no client attached, freshest first (ztmux extension)
  disk                  filesystem usage behind each pane's cwd (ztmux extension)
  doctor                environment / server health check (ztmux extension)
  elapsed               how long each pane's process has been running (ztmux extension)
  env                   per-session environment overrides (ztmux extension)
  equalize              re-balance every multi-pane window's layout (ztmux extension)
  events                stream server lifecycle events as JSONL (ztmux extension)
  fanout                sessions ranked by total pane count (ztmux extension)
  finder                search panes by command/path/title/window (ztmux extension)
  focus                 the active pane of every window (ztmux extension)
  git                   git branch + dirty state of every pane's repo (ztmux extension)
  gone                  panes whose working directory no longer exists (ztmux extension)
  graph                 render the server tree as DOT/Mermaid/HTML (ztmux extension)
  grep                  search the live contents of every pane (ztmux extension)
  groups                cluster sessions by session group (ztmux extension)
  history               rank panes by scrollback buffer size (ztmux extension)
  hooks                 the command hooks configured on each session (ztmux extension)
  idle                  attached clients ranked by time since last activity (ztmux extension)
  info                  deep inspector for a single pane (ztmux extension)
  input                 panes that are ignoring keyboard input (ztmux extension)
  keys                  how many key bindings live in each key table (ztmux extension)
  keytable              clients parked on a non-root key table (ztmux extension)
  layout                apply a named layout preset to a window (ztmux extension)
  layouts               the current layout string of every window (ztmux extension)
  limit                 each session's scrollback capacity, largest first (ztmux extension)
  linked                windows linked into more than one session (ztmux extension)
  marks                 the marked pane(s) (ztmux extension)
  mem                   panes ranked by process resident memory (ztmux extension)
  modal                 zellij-style modal keybindings: pane/tab/resize/session/lock modes (ztmux extension)
  mode                  panes currently frozen in a mode (ztmux extension)
  monitor               windows armed to alert on activity or silence (ztmux extension)
  mouse                 which sessions have mouse mode enabled (ztmux extension)
  named                 windows with a deliberate name, not the running command (ztmux extension)
  nested                panes running a nested terminal multiplexer (ztmux extension)
  net                   established outbound connections per pane (ztmux extension)
  open                  pick a URL or file path out of the current pane and open it (ztmux extension)
  peek                  dump the visible contents of every pane (ztmux extension)
  pick                  batch sync/unmark/clear over the multi-pane mark set (ztmux extension)
  piped                 panes with an active pipe-pane capture (ztmux extension)
  ports                 listening TCP ports mapped to panes (ztmux extension)
  project               project kind and root behind every pane (ztmux extension)
  prune                 remove dead/empty/idle server objects (ztmux extension)
  ps                    one-shot pipeable per-pane process table (ztmux extension)
  pstree                process tree running under every pane (ztmux extension)
  readonly              clients attached in read-only mode (ztmux extension)
  recent                list sessions ranked by last activity (ztmux extension)
  remain                windows that keep panes open after they exit (ztmux extension)
  remote                the git remote each pane's repo points at (ztmux extension)
  repl                  interactive console over every ztmux verb (ztmux extension)
  resurrect             save/restore all sessions across restarts (ztmux extension)
  retitle               label every pane with its running command (ztmux extension)
  revive                revive every dead pane in place (ztmux extension)
  sessions              zellij-style session manager: switch/rename/kill/new (ztmux extension)
  shadow                install the ~/.ztmux shadow: tmux shim, man pages, completion (ztmux extension)
  shells                panes sitting at a bare shell prompt (ztmux extension)
  size                  report pane geometry, smallest first (ztmux extension)
  snapshot              dump the whole server as one nested JSON document (ztmux extension)
  solo                  windows holding a single, unsplit pane (ztmux extension)
  ssh                   which panes hold an SSH connection, and where (ztmux extension)
  stack                 zellij-style pane stacks: toggle, unstack, refocus (ztmux extension)
  startcmd              the command line each pane was launched with (ztmux extension)
  stash                 repositories with stashed work behind a pane (ztmux extension)
  state                 panes whose process is in an abnormal state (ztmux extension)
  stats                 one-shot server summary report (ztmux extension)
  status                sessions with the status line turned off (ztmux extension)
  submodules            repos with submodules and how many are out of sync (ztmux extension)
  switcher              interactive session/window/pane picker (ztmux extension)
  sync                  windows with synchronize-panes turned on (ztmux extension)
  tabs                  zellij-style top tab bar of windows (ztmux extension)
  tag                   the git describe/tag context of every pane's repo (ztmux extension)
  term                  histogram of attached client terminal types (ztmux extension)
  titlebar              sessions that push a title to the outer terminal (ztmux extension)
  titles                every pane's advertised title (ztmux extension)
  tree                  print the session/window/pane tree (ztmux extension)
  triggers              run a ztmux command when a regex matches pane output (ztmux extension)
  tty                   map every pane to its terminal device (ztmux extension)
  usage                 per-session CPU/MEM/RSS resource rollup (ztmux extension)
  user                  the owner of every pane's process (ztmux extension)
  utf8                  the UTF-8 state of every attached client (ztmux extension)
  vcs                   which version-control system each pane is under (ztmux extension)
  verbs                 list every verb ztmux answers to, with descriptions (ztmux extension)
  viewers               how many clients are attached to each session (ztmux extension)
  visual                sessions that show alerts visually instead of just beeping (ztmux extension)
  watch                 top-like live per-pane process monitor (ztmux extension)
  who                   clients attached to the server, by session (ztmux extension)
  winsize               windows whose sizing mode differs from the default (ztmux extension)
  worktree              panes sitting in a linked git worktree (ztmux extension)
  writable              panes whose working directory is read-only (ztmux extension)
  zoom                  windows with a zoomed pane (ztmux extension)

CONSOLE (18)
  cat                   print files to stdout (console builtin)
  cd                    change the console's working directory (console builtin)
  clear                 clear the screen (console builtin)
  cp                    copy files, or directories with -r (console builtin)
  dir                   list a directory, -a all -l long -t by time -r reversed (console builtin)
  echo                  print the arguments, -n without a newline (console builtin)
  exit                  leave the console (console builtin)
  export                set an environment variable for later lines (console builtin)
  help                  show the console keys and builtins (console builtin)
  ln                    create a hard link, or a symlink with -s (console builtin)
  mkdir                 create directories, -p with parents (console builtin)
  mv                    move or rename files (console builtin)
  printenv              print the environment, or one variable (console builtin)
  pwd                   print the console's working directory (console builtin)
  quit                  leave the console (console builtin)
  rm                    remove files, -r directories -f ignore missing (console builtin)
  touch                 create files, or bump their mtime (console builtin)
  unset                 remove environment variables (console builtin)
